name: ConsultBae Candidate Ingestion, Deduplication & AI Skill Tagging Pipeline

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger: New Applicant / CSV Upload

parameters.query: SELECT id, full_name, email, phone, city, skill_category, data_sources FROM candidates WHERE (phone IS NOT NULL AND phone = '{{ $json.phone }}') OR (email IS NOT NULL AND email = '{{ $json.email }}') LIMIT 1;

parameters.name: text
parameters.value:
=:warning: *ConsultBae Duplicate Alert*
*Candidate:* {{ $json.matched_candidate_name }} (ID: #{{ $json.matched_existing_id }})
*Matched On:* Phone: `{{ $json.matched_phone }}` | Email: `{{ $json.matched_email }}`
*Existing Sources:* {{ $json.data_sources }}

parameters.text:
=You are an expert technical talent categorization engine at ConsultBae.
Given the following candidate skills: "{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.skills }}"

Classify this candidate into exactly ONE of the following official categories:
- Automation & AI Heavy (if skills include n8n, zapier, langchain, llm, ai automation, python workflows)
- Web & Fullstack (if skills include react, javascript, typescript, fastapi, node, rest apis, angular)
- Data & Analytics (if skills include sql, mysql, mongodb, pandas, etl, data warehousing)
- QA & Web Scraping (if skills include selenium, web scraping, playwright, testing)
- General Software Engineering (fallback)

Return a valid JSON object with keys:
"category": string,
"confidence": number,
"primary_tools": array of strings,
"reasoning": string

parameters.query: INSERT INTO candidates (full_name, email, phone, city, skills, skill_category, status, data_sources) VALUES ('{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.full_name }}', '{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.email }}', '{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.phone }}', '{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.city }}', '{{ $('Normalize & Sanitize Payload').item.json.skills }}', '{{ $json.category || 'General' }}', 'Active', 'n8n_Webhook_Automation');
